استنبطوا (form X)
# اِسْتَنْبَطُوا (istanbaṭū) /is.tan.ba.tˤuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَنْبَطَ (istanbaṭa)
# اُسْتُنْبِطُوا (ustunbiṭū) /us.tun.bi.tˤuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَنْبَطَ (istanbaṭa)
# اِسْتَنْبِطُوا (istanbiṭū) /is.tan.bi.tˤuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَنْبَطَ (istanbaṭa)
